findings.issue: The catalog presents --extend-minutes=M as a flag that on its own reopens a completed run. The code makes it a modifier that is only valid alongside --extend: `.skilled/commands/deep/assets/deep-review.yaml:60` declares it "Only valid with --extend" and the preflight at `:404` makes "extend_minutes without extend" a usage error before the lock is taken, so `/deep:review --extend-minutes=30` alone fails instead of reopening anything. `--extend-minutes` also does not set maxIterations; it only raises maxDurationMinutes (deep-review.yaml:544-547, deep-research.yaml:517-520).

404:          - extend_values: "When extend is bound it must be a positive integer (digits only, no sign, at least 1), and extend_minutes when bound likewise. extend_minutes without extend, or extend with a lineage_mode other than auto or completed-continue, is a usage error. Each fails here, before step_acquire_lock, with a usage error that names the flag."

fix.old: The --extend=N and --extend-minutes=M flags on /deep:research and /deep:review reopen a completed single-executor run in place, and leave the registry-driven workflowMode, runtimeLoopType and backendKind classification unchanged.
fix.new: The --extend=N flag on /deep:research and /deep:review reopens a completed single-executor run in place, and --extend-minutes=M adds minutes to that run's duration budget and is valid only alongside --extend. Neither flag changes the registry-driven workflowMode, runtimeLoopType and backendKind classification.

findings.issue: The README states unconditionally that "A review can also track custom dimensions beside its four defaults". Two code facts contradict the "beside" reading. First, a named dimension list is a filter, not an addition: deep-review.yaml:804 ("If review_dimensions != \"all\", filter to only requested dimensions") and :826 ("correctness,performance" -> ["correctness","performance"]) mean a custom-only request drops the four canonical dimensions, and convergence.cjs:1599-1601 then treats only `config.reviewDimensions`/coverage keys as the dimension universe. Second, every fan-out review lineage is bound to `review_dimensions: all` in both dispatch paths, so a configured custom dimension never reaches a fan-out review at all: fanout-run.cjs:1743 (CLI lineage setup bindings) and :1842 (native command input).
